entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Mayank Gupta For Respondent(s) : Mr. Shyam Prakash Sharma, PP.
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE NARENDRA SINGH DHADDHA Order 28/07/2021 Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the samples were taken in 2011.

At that time, the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act has already been repealed by Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and as such the proceedings initiated under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act are illegal.
Learned Public Prosecutor seeks time to argue the matter.
List the matters after two weeks.
In the meantime, proceeding pending before the Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate No.9, Jaipur Metropolitan shall remain stayed.
